rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for suggesting a plan or course of action.

example.english: I propose that we meet next week to discuss this matter.
example.traditional: 我提議下個星期開會討論呢件事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai4 ji5 haa6 go3 sing1 kei4 hoi1 wui2 tou2 leon6 ni1 gin6 si6

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone asks another person to marry them.

example.english: He finally decides to propose to his girlfriend.
example.traditional: 佢終於同女朋友求婚喇。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zung1 jyu1 tung4 neoi5 pang4 jau5 kau4 fan1 laa3
